label: FP
reason: User input flows through bar into MessageDigest.hash() which transforms input into a non-user-controllable hash value. The output is then Base64-encoded and HTML-encoded via ESAPI before display. XSS payloads cannot survive the cryptographic hash transformation, making the reported path effectively mitigated.

evidence.note: StringBuilder modifies param to bar, replacing most chars with Z
bar is hashed via MessageDigest, destroying original user input
Hashed output is HTML-encoded via ESAPI before printing
